regressions: NEW WRONG HIGH EDGES from import aliases (the same change that fixed TSX <CalendarPrimitive>): a call through 'import { X as Y }' is now bound to the original name X, but to a same-named symbol that is near (usually the enclosing function) instead of the imported one. A diff of the complete edge set (round-one binary vs this binary, same checkout) shows 13 such new wrong high edges: baseServeStatic (alias of serveStatic) -> the enclosing serveStatic in adapters/{bun,cloudflare-workers,deno}/src/serve-static.ts and src/adapter/{bun,cloudflare-workers,deno}/serve-static.ts (6 self-edges); baseToSSG (alias of toSSG) -> the enclosing toSSG in adapters/{bun,deno}/src/ssg.ts and src/adapter/{bun,deno}/ssg.ts (4 self-edges); src/jsx/components.test.tsx:14 and :25 rawResolveCallback (alias of utils/html resolveCallback) -> the local test function resolveCallback; src/jsx/dom/server.ts:68 renderToReadableStreamHono (alias of ../streaming renderToReadableStream) -> the enclosing renderToReadableStream. Three other new alias edges are right (src/jsx/dom/index.test.tsx:3241, 3253 createElementForDom and :3282 cloneElementForDom -> dom/index.ts). Net: 13 wrong to 3 right. The one wrong edge in this round's 30-edge high sample (adapters/bun/src/serve-static.ts:25) is one of them, so high-tier precision is a floor of about 13 wrong in the high population of 1,205 CALLS, not 1 in 30.

findings: Definitions are complete on the five files: 291 of 291, 0 missed, 0 spurious; private #members, the JSX namespace and (elsewhere) overload folding all work as stated.

The import-alias binding added since round one produces 13 new wrong high edges in this project (6 serveStatic and 4 toSSG self-edges in the adapter wrappers, 2 resolveCallback and 1 renderToReadableStream in the JSX tests/server), against 3 new right ones. The stated reason is the same fix that makes TSX <CalendarPrimitive> work; for an aliased import the resolver picks a nearby same-named symbol without checking the import path.
